sentences.span: the gap between diesel and crude oil prices has continued to widen since early July
sentences.why: MS's oil tracker shows crude and refined-product (diesel) prices diverging, driven by refinery/Hormuz disruptions cutting effective diesel supply while crude reflects headline geopolitical risk — matches the crude/refined-fuel split described.

sentences.span: Markets seem to only react badly when actual events affecting energy prices occur. Markets seem to react positively to any story, rumor, or hope that is positive.
sentences.why: Academy Securities (Tchir) states directly that energy markets rally on any positive rumor/story/hope — supports the mechanism the sentence describes.

sentences.span: remove that shock absorber and GIR says fair value is roughly $10-15 higher
sentences.why: The fair-value view on crude in the sources is Goldman Sachs's own GIR estimate (via Jared Cohen, GS Global Institute), not JPMorgan's. No document anywhere in the corpus attributes a crude fair-value call to JPMorgan.

sentences.span: those buffers are now seen as fading, leaving oil prices increasingly vulnerable to further geopolitical disruptions
sentences.why: MS explicitly frames the protective buffers (exports, Chinese demand, inventories) as fading — meaning the shock is worsening, not that 'the shock was already fading.' No source states the oil shock itself was already fading as of last week's hikes.

sentences.span: On the Trump-Xi meeting, the only thing that matters is any signal Xi is shifting away from 'playing for time'
sentences.why: The Trump-Xi meeting as the crude-defining catalyst and the fair-value framing both trace to Goldman Sachs (Jared Cohen/GIR), not JPMorgan. Additionally, no source anywhere mentions BofA being short 2-year Treasuries or the $SHY ticker at all — that half of the sentence has no source support.

This sentence describes the pulse's own prior trade call and its outcome — internal editorial continuity, not a claim from any research PDF in the source set. No source document can support or contradict it.

sentences.span: capital expenditures have exploded, driving down FCF... FCF will bottom in the third quarter of 2027 at about -$265 billion
sentences.why: MS shows hyperscaler free cash flow collapsing (and going deeply negative) as AI capex explodes; combined with GS's hyperscaler IG debt issuance data (2027 estimate $400-420bn, +60% y/y) this supports capex now being funded by bond markets, which the sentence links onward to yields.

sentences.span: isn't a situation of price outrunning the fundamentals
sentences.why: GS's own Coppersmith note lays out both the bearish breadth/sentiment read and the bullish earnings/valuation counter in the same piece — a transition sentence describing that structure, grounded in the source.

No source document contains a BofA fund manager survey overinvestment statistic, nor a Goldman semiconductor gross-margin figure of 70% against a 15-year average of 55%, nor any 'tenth of S&P 500 earnings' impact estimate.

sentences.span: Markets are now pricing in a greater than 50% chance of a hike in October
sentences.why: MS states odds are 'greater than 50%' — leaning toward a hike, not an even-money toss-up. 'Coin flip' misstates the direction/confidence of the market pricing.

sentences.span: The two-year Treasury yield rose by 0.1 percentage points to 4.7%
sentences.why: The 4.744% cited matches (by value, allowing for rounding) Generali's reported 2-year yield of 4.7% after the hawkish FOMC hike; MS separately corroborates 2yr yields 'approaching 4.75%' on >50%-priced October hike odds, supporting the conditional logic.

sentences.span: buying over the last 1w and 1m in tech, fins, materials, discretionary … selling over the last 1w and 1m in healthcare, real estate, energy, and industrials
sentences.why: GS's own prime-brokerage flow data for the period shows buying in tech AND financials together, with selling concentrated in healthcare/real estate/energy/industrials — not a rotation out of AI-enabling semiconductors into financials. A second GS note (Coppersmith) separately shows Tech as the most net-bought sector for three straight weeks, the opposite of money 'leaving' semis.

sentences.span: Less than 30% of S&P stocks are now above the 50-day moving average
sentences.why: GS's Coppersmith note lays out exactly this pattern: resilient headline index, deteriorating breadth/sentiment underneath, and inflows that aren't one-way — supporting 'damage spread across the average stock while a few names carry the index' and 'none of this looks like panic selling.'

The BOJ hike itself is corroborated generically ('After the BOJ hiked on Thursday night' — Bear Traps) and JGB yields are noted at multi-decade highs (fixed income bulletin), but no source states the new rate level (1.25%), that it's the highest since 1995, the 7-2 vote count, or dissents from board members appointed by PM Takaichi.
